THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation hereby declare under sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Boundaries to the following parcels of land mention in detail in Surveyor General's schedule No. GM/DOM/2022/480 dated 19.06.2023 and located in the Village called Meddegama in 383 - Meddegama Grama Niladhari Division of Dompe Divisional Secretary's Division in Gampaha District of the Western Province are:

01. Lot 'A ' - Maligawatta - Extent: 2.1337 Hectares North: Lot No. 294 (Road) in Sheet 01 Zone 2 Kasi 511014 and Wekewatta also known as Maligawatta claimed by Vana SEWANA SADAHAM VIHARA dayaka Sabha; East: The
Road; South: Lot B, Wekewatta also known as Maligawatta claimed by Ananda Wijitha Wijethilaka and the Road; West: The Road and Lot No. 294 (Road) in Sheet 01 Zone 2 Kasi 511014.
02. Lot 'B' - Maligawatta - Extent: 0.0251 Hectare North: Lot A; East: The Road; South: Lot C; West: Wekewata also known as Maligawatta claimed by Ananda Wijitha Wijethilaka.

03. Lot 'C' - Maligawatta - Extent: 3.9947 Hectares North: The canal, Lot Nos. 142, 141, 140, 373 and 139 in Sheet 01 Zone 2 Kasi 511051, the canal, Wakewatta also known as Maligawatta claimed by Anada Wijitha Wijethilaka and Lot B of this schedule; East: The Road and Maligawatta claimed by Central Environment Authority; South: The Road and Maligawatta claimed by Central Environment Authority and Lot D; West: The Canal, Lot Nos. 142, 141, 140, 373 and 139 in Sheet 01 Zone 2 Kasi 511051.
04. Lot 'D' - Not mention - Extent: 0.0032 Hectare North: Lot C; East: Maligawatta claimed by the Central Environment Authority; South: Lot E; West: The Canal.
